assets.name: Highland Plateau
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: separate high-resolution 16:9 landscape background for the planetary settlement screen of a polished space strategy game.
Generate ONE image, not a contact sheet or collage. A new habitable planet surface viewed from an elevated, oblique near-orbital camera. Match this consistent layout across the series: black space with a few subtle stars in the upper fifth; a gently curved, blue atmospheric horizon rising near 20% of the image height in the middle and dropping to roughly 32% at the edges; expansive terrain fills the lower three quarters. Distant hills sit toward the horizon. The middle and foreground have broad, relatively level land areas where the game can later overlay building sprites. This is a planetary surface panorama, NOT a small whole globe and NOT a ground-level landscape.
Style: sophisticated semi-realistic 3D game environment illustration, natural materials, coherent landscape-scale geology, restrained detail and readable large forms. Soft sunlight from upper left, subtle atmospheric depth, balanced contrast, beautiful but not oversharpened. A welcoming habitable world, with visible liquid water and living vegetation.
Do not include buildings, roads, cities, spaceships, people, animals, crop fields, interface, text, labels, frames, logos, or watermarks. Do not draw a placement grid or empty UI boxes. Do not make it airless, uniformly barren, or a generic Earth globe. Opaque background.
Biome-specific request: Wide elevated grassy plateaus with broad accessible flat tops; exposed rust, copper, cream and slate mineral-striped escarpments at their edges; winding blue freshwater rivers in green valleys; sparse woodland pockets. Emerald and olive vegetation with warm geological accents. No snowy alpine skyline. Open grassy foreground with a few broad rock outcrops, not an all-rock desert.
